title: Causal exclusion favors the optimal macro level

statements.text: Accepting causal exclusion (causation at one level only, to avoid double counting) turns it against reductionism: when the macro has higher EI, macro causation excludes micro causation.

sources.locator: Discussion, Causal Exclusion and Its Implications
sources.quote: to avoid double-counting causes, optimal macro causation must exclude micro causation
